title: Paul and the False Apostles, Paul's Sufferings

questions.question: Paul asks the Corinthians to bear with him in a little ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 11:1 (ESV): "I wish you would bear with me in a little foolishness. Do bear with me!"

questions.question: For I feel a divine jealousy for you, since I betrothed you to one husband, to present you as a ____ to Christ.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 11:2 (ESV): "For I feel a divine jealousy for you, since I betrothed you to one husband, to present you as a pure virgin to Christ."

questions.question: Paul is afraid that as the ____ deceived Eve by his cunning, their thoughts will be led astray from a sincere and pure devotion to Christ.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 11:3 (ESV): "But I am afraid that as the serpent deceived Eve by his cunning, your thoughts will be led astray from a sincere and pure devotion to Christ."

questions.question: For if someone comes and proclaims another ____ than the one we proclaimed, or if you receive a different spirit... or accept a different gospel, you put up with it readily enough.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 11:4 (ESV): "For if someone comes and proclaims another Jesus than the one we proclaimed, or if you receive a different spirit... or if you accept a different gospel, you put up with it readily enough."

questions.question: Indeed, Paul considers that he is not in the least inferior to these "____ apostles."
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 11:5 (ESV): "Indeed, I consider that I am not in the least inferior to these super-apostles."

questions.question: Did Paul commit a sin in humbling himself so that they might be exalted, because he preached God's gospel to them ____?
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 11:7 (ESV): "Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself so that you might be exalted, because I preached God's gospel to you free of charge?"

questions.question: Paul says he "robbed" other churches by accepting support from them in order to ____ the Corinthians.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 11:8 (ESV): "I robbed other churches by accepting support from them in order to serve you."

questions.question: And when Paul was with them and was in need, he did not burden anyone, for the brothers who came from ____ supplied his need.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 11:9 (ESV): "And when I was with you and was in need, I did not burden anyone, for the brothers who came from Macedonia supplied my need."

questions.question: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workmen, disguising themselves as ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 11:13 (ESV): "For such men are false apostles, deceitful workmen, disguising themselves as apostles of Christ."

questions.question: And no wonder, for even ____ disguises himself as an angel of light.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 11:14 (ESV): "And no wonder, for even Satan disguises himself as an angel of light."

questions.question: So it is no surprise if his servants, also, disguise themselves as servants of ____. Their end will correspond to their deeds.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 11:15 (ESV): "So it is no surprise if his servants, also, disguise themselves as servants of righteousness. Their end will correspond to their deeds."

questions.question: Paul lists his sufferings. Five times he received at the hands of the Jews the forty lashes less ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 11:24 (ESV): "Five times I received at the hands of the Jews the forty lashes less one."

questions.question: Three times he was beaten with rods. Once he was ____. Three times he was shipwrecked; a night and a day he was adrift at sea.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 11:25 (ESV): "Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I was shipwrecked; a night and a day I was adrift at sea;"

questions.question: And, apart from other things, there is the daily pressure on him of his anxiety for ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 11:28 (ESV): "And, apart from other things, there is the daily pressure on me of my anxiety for all the churches."

questions.question: If Paul must boast, he will boast of the things that show his ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 11:30 (ESV): "If I must boast, I will boast of the things that show my weakness."

key_verse_text: And no wonder, for even Satan disguises himself as an angel of light.
